hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".command"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "(DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE)|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+push\s+-f\b|git\s+reset\s+--hard|rm\s+-rf\s+/|format\s+[A-Z]:)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'CMD=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".command"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "^(pytest|npm test)"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"PreToolUse\", \"permissionDecision\": \"allow\", \"updatedInput\": {\"command\": \"$CMD | grep -E \\\"(PASS|FAIL|ERROR|error:|passed|failed)\\\" || echo \\\"All tests passed\\\"\"}}}"; else echo "{}"; fi'

bash -c 'CONTENT=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".content // .new_string // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CONTENT" ] && echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qEi "(api[_-]?key\s*=\s*[\x27\"][A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|api[_-]?secret\s*=|aws_access_key_id\s*=\s*[\x27\"]AK|aws_secret_access_key|password\s*=\s*[\x27\"][^\x27\"]{8,}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN\s+(RSA|EC|DSA)?\s*PRIVATE\s+KEY)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Potential secret/API key detected in code. Use environment variables instead." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(env|pem|key)$"; then if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.env\.example$"; then exit 0; fi; echo "BLOCKED: Writing to secret file ($FILE). Use .env.example for templates." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path" | grep -qE "\.(jsx?|tsx?)$"; then FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path"); cd frontend_react && npx prettier --write "../$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(test|spec)\.(ts|js|tsx|jsx|py)$"; then CONTENT=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".content // .new_string // empty" 2>/dev/null); WARNINGS=""; if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "toBeTruthy\(\)"; then WARNINGS="$WARNINGS
- toBeTruthy() detected (weak assertion)"; fi; if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "(test\.skip|xit\(|xdescribe\(|@pytest\.mark\.skip)"; then WARNINGS="$WARNINGS
- Skipped test detected"; fi; if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "timeout:\s*[0-9]{5,}"; then WARNINGS="$WARNINGS
- Large timeout detected (possible timeout inflation)"; fi; if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "catch\s*\(.*\)\s*\{\s*\}"; then WARNINGS="$WARNINGS
- Empty catch block in test"; fi; if [ -n "$WARNINGS" ]; then echo "WARNING: Possible test weakening in $FILE:$WARNINGS" >&2; fi; fi'
